description.content:
WebSocket endpoint for agentic browser interaction. Connect to establish a
persistent browser session, then send JSON-RPC messages to control the browser.

Uses a simple JSON protocol instead of GraphQL:
Send: { "id": 1, "method": "goto", "params": { "url": "https://example.com" } }
Receive: { "id": 1, "result": { "status": 200, "url": "https://example.com" } }

All BQL mutations are available as methods (goto, click, type, screenshot, etc.).
Additionally supports a "snapshot" method that returns interactive page elements
with CSS selectors, plus tab-management methods (getTabs, switchTab, createTab,
closeTab) for multi-tab workflows.
